_comment: CANONICAL map of the user-level (global) skill directories each provider reads, consumed by scripts/lib/devteam/global_skills.py (ADR-0020). One entry per PHYSICAL directory: several providers can read the same one, so a skill is listed once with every provider that sees it. `~` is the user's home ($DEVTEAM_USER_HOME overrides it, for tests). `install_target` names the root a new skill is written to for each provider.
_why_codex_targets_agents: Codex reads user skills from ~/.agents/skills; ~/.codex/skills is its older location and also holds the provider's own bundled skills under .system/. It is still listed so what is already there stays visible and removable, but nothing new is written to it.
